fields.System.Title: CNT-402 — Variance rate by product class
fields.System.Description:
Story

As an inventory controller, I want accuracy broken down by product class, so that I
can spot when a group of products has a master data problem.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a date range, then I get variance rates grouped by ABC class and by product
  • category.
  • - Given a single product with repeated variances, then it is listed individually.
  • - Given a product whose variances cluster around its case quantity, then that pattern is
  • highlighted — it usually means the case quantity is wrong.
  • - Given the report, then it links to the products so master data can be checked.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | counting, masterdata |
| Tables | accuracy projection, variance, product |
| Risks | Wrong case quantity multiplying silently ([doc 03 §7.1](../../../docs/03-master-data.md)) |
| Tests | integration |
